content.short: Intract Gate3 is a DAO operations tool.
content.description: Intract Gate3 delivers a growth marketing and analytics suite for Web3 marketers and project founders. It helps you assess, map, and optimize your campaigns and strategies, identify the most relevant wallets with on-chain targeting, and engage Web3 users and affiliates through quests and giveaways. You can map marketing ROI and channel CAC, create allowlists and token gates, and leverage a community CRM for attribution. Supported chains include Arbitrum, Ethereum, Fantom, Polygon, Multichain, Base, Solana, and OP Mainnet.
